creator: Alexander Terp
description: On 2026-10-16 the owner screenshotted two stuck Codex rows in the sidebar and asked what the red status meant. The dot was systemPink (stuck); the red was each row's context ring, one of them at 83%. docs/architecture.md keeps stuck pink so that red stays the context ring's alone, but at sidebar dot size in dark mode systemPink and systemRed sit close enough that the two read as one color, on the same row. Worth a look at a more distinct stuck color, or a second cue on the dot (a shape or a glyph), so the legend survives a glance.
title: A stuck agent's pink dot reads as red beside the context ring
